authority: spec-kitty-cli release authority for shared package compatibility

packages.contract_surface: volatile mission/WP families + zeitgeist attrs codecs; status-diary reducer with causal (from-lane-continuity) rejection precedence, generalized to every current setter (10.4.1, #5967; built on 10.4.0, #4990) and exempting a migration/backfill reconstruction-seed current setter so it cannot bury a WP's real recorded lifecycle (10.4.2, spec-kitty-events#78), a seed that loses that contest still folding its claim slots and backfilled verdict where no real event wrote them, so a backfilled rejection is not overridden by a bare approval (10.4.3/10.4.4, spec-kitty#6058, spec-kitty-events#80), a rollback-shaped reconstruction seed never taking a lane it does not continue except against its bare sibling approval (10.4.6, spec-kitty#6061, with the equal-`at` approved->done ordering fix, spec-kitty-events#87), and a non-seed departure from `approved` ordered after the approval it followed so a clock-ahead rejection is not sorted before its approval and dropped (10.5.1, spec-kitty#4941, spec-kitty-events#102); typed WorkObservation contract (10.1.0)
packages.resolution_note: The CLI consumes the public PyPI release train with a bounded range; 10.5.1 is the release-authority lock target. 10.4.1 generalized from-lane continuity to every setter (closing the cancel/rework split-brain the 10.4.0 rollback-setter-only form missed) but over-rejected migrated missions: a genesis-time migration:backfill reconstruction seed became the current setter and dropped the WP's real lifecycle. 10.4.2 (spec-kitty-events#78) exempts a reconstruction-seed current setter so the real lifecycle wins, with the #5967 cancel/rework fix and the rollback/force exemptions unchanged (spec-kitty-events#77/#78 / spec-kitty#5967). 10.4.3/10.4.4 (spec-kitty#6058) fold a losing seed's claim slots and backfilled verdict per slot, fill-if-absent, which restores the verdict-backfill rejection that 10.4.2's exemption let a bare approval override (spec-kitty#6084, spec-kitty-events#80). 10.4.6 (spec-kitty#6061) stops a rollback-shaped verdict seed from taking a lane its lifecycle did not continue, except against its bare sibling approval, so a merged done WP no longer reads in_progress and a never-claimed WP no longer reads in_progress; the same release orders an equal-at real approved->done correctly (spec-kitty-events#87). 10.4.5 was never published. 10.5.1 (spec-kitty#4941, spec-kitty-events#102) lifts a non-seed departure from `approved` to sort after the approval it followed, so a reviewer's rejection recorded on a clock behind a clock-ahead approval is no longer sorted before it and dropped as causally stale; this is the P0 the CLI consumes in spec-kitty#6261.
The CLI consumes the public PyPI release train with a bounded range; 0.5.2 is the release-authority lock target.
